title: Deploy-ready analytics platform and Vercel integration
body: ## Summary - added production backend/API + Postgres integration for Web3 Twitter analytics - added CoinMarketCap one-shot sync and continuous worker scheduler (`npm run worker:cmc`) - added Cursor cloud environment config (`.cursor/environment.json`, `.cursor/Dockerfile`) - deployed current branch to Vercel production and fixed routing for static assets - added `.gitignore` entry for `.vercel` metadata directory - added a standalone Lastmile weekly-report package under `lastmile-weekly/` preserving the same template/design - updated Lastmile content for the week starting **21 Sep 2026**: - TaskOn campaign started on 21 Sep - weekly plan text expanded for this sprint - explicit week goals set to **minimum 10x engagement** and **minimum 10x follower growth** - Galxe status set to waiting for team confirmation - ambassador/KOL execution narrative updated for this week - published a temporary live deployment of the updated Lastmile page for immediate use ## API endpoints (analytics platform) - `GET /api/health` - `GET /api/projects` - `GET /api/projects/:projectId/campaigns` - `GET /api/projects/:projectId/campaigns/:campaignId/analytics` ## Worker commands - `npm run sync:cmc` (one-shot) - `npm run worker:cmc` (continuous interval worker) ## Validation - `npm run check` - `node --check src/scripts/cmcWorker.js` - `node --check src/services/priceSync.js` - `node --check src/scripts/syncCmc.js` - verified Lastmile JSON payloads parse successfully - verified deployed Lastmile `weeks.json` and `overall.json` include 21 Sep sprint updates
